ideas.pitch: A reverse-proxy gateway designed to intercept, sanitize, and block indirect prompt injections and jailbreaks targeting enterprise LLM APIs in real time.
ideas.title: PromptShield Proxy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core theme of securing the AI-powered enterprise by solving LLM jailbreaking and prompt injection, following the defense-in-depth architectural pattern seen in winning security agents.

ideas.pitch: A retrieval-augmented generation security layer that scans ingested enterprise documents for training data poisoning and malicious vector embeddings before they enter the vector database.
ideas.title: RAGSanitizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses RAG Poisoning and Training Data Poisoning, two high-priority vulnerabilities for enterprise AI implementations highlighted in the challenge guidelines.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous runtime monitor that detects and blocks privilege escalation attacks and unauthorized tool calls within agentic AI workflows.
ideas.title: AgenticGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles Agentic AI Privilege Escalation, providing a novel defense mechanism for multi-agent enterprise deployments using graph intelligence and behavioral anomaly detection.

ideas.pitch: A specialized security wrapper and query parser that neutralizes Natural Language to SQL (NL2SQL) injection attacks before database execution.
ideas.title: SQLArmor AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on NL2SQL Injection, a specific enterprise threat vector mentioned in the challenge criteria, offering robust technical depth and immediate utility for secure database interactions.

ideas.pitch: An automated security scanner for checking third-party AI models, datasets, and dependencies for vulnerabilities and backdoor triggers.
ideas.title: AISupplyChain Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves AI Supply Chain Security challenges by combining static analysis with behavioral probing, fulfilling the demand for rigorous red-teaming tools.
